subject: Renewal: sandbox carve-out + term revision for Mediform
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediform.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@mediform.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — request to add isolated analytics sandbox and term change

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As we prepare to renew our Private environment agreement later this quarter, we have two asks we'd like Redwood to price and commit to in the renewal:

1) Add an isolated analytics sandbox (separate VPC) for our product analytics team — roughly 4 dedicated GPUs equivalent, pre-warmed staging capacity, isolated KV caching, and a separate service account. This environment will be used for nightly batch evals and sandboxed experiments.

2) Move to a 24‑month term (currently on 12) if we can get a predictable unit price and a 7% term discount. We also want the option to add two extra clusters mid-term at a pre-negotiated uplift.

I attached the draft SOW (Mediform_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short runbook of acceptance criteria. Can you confirm feasibility and a target timeline for provisioning? We are aiming for the new environment live before the end of Q1.

Cheers,
Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Engineering, Mediform Health
elena.soto@mediform.com
+1 415-555-0198

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — request to add isolated analytics sandbox and term change

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can support an isolated analytics sandbox and a 24‑month term with a committed uplift option.

High-level plan and assumptions:
- Provisioning: isolated VPC + 4x GPU nodes in a dedicated cluster; we can deliver a pre-warmed staging pool (2 nodes hot, autoscale to 4).
- Timeline: provisioning & acceptance testing in ~9-10 weeks from signed SOW (aiming for late Q1 as requested).
- Pricing: I have a preliminary pricing summary in sandbox_pricing_summary.xlsx — includes monthly run-rate for the sandbox, one-time provisioning fee, and an optional add-cluster uplift price.
- Term/discount: our standard 24‑month commit discount band starts at 5%; I can escalate a 7% band to the RevOps lead for approval if Mediform can commit to the pre-negotiated mid-term cluster uplift (we'll need a firm notice window).

Next steps: 1) internal review for the 7% discount; 2) I'll loop in Prioyom/DAS for SOW technical acceptance criteria; 3) send an updated quote (with DocuSign) by EOD Tuesday.

Would it help to get a short technical call with Karthik to review isolation controls (KMS, audit logging, network ACLs)? We can book 30 minutes.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal planning — request to add isolated analytics sandbox and term change

Mina / team — quick internal notes on pricing and ops before we send the customer the escalated discount: 

- Margin check: baseline cost for 4x A10G-equivalent nodes (quantized inference profiles) + pre-warm reserve and separate KV cache increases unit cost ~36% vs shared cluster. One-time infra setup: $12k.
- Term discount: 7% is tighter than our standard 24m band; acceptable if Mediform guarantees the uplift purchase window and a minimum monthly commitment. Recommend we require a 60-day advance notification for mid-term cluster adds.
- SLA/ops: require SOC2 evidence and a signed extension for retention/audit logs for the sandbox — PRIO: sync with Security to avoid last-minute hold.

If everyone agrees, I'll draft the exact contract language (amendment) for the term/notification window and the mid-term uplift pricing.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediform.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — request to add isolated analytics sandbox and term change

Hi Elena — following up with an updated summary and next steps.

Summary (agreed internal alignment):
- Provision: Dedicated analytics sandbox (isolated VPC) — 4 GPU-equivalent nodes, pre-warmed pool of 2 nodes, autoscale to 4. One-time provisioning fee: $12,000. Monthly run-rate: $34,500 (includes dedicated KV cache and reserved capacity).
- Term: 24 months with a 7% discount applied to the total committed run-rate, contingent on: 1) signed 24‑month amendment and 2) a 60-day formal notice for any mid-term cluster adds.
- Mid-term uplift: pre-negotiated add-cluster uplift price = $28,000 per cluster (one-time provisioning); clusters can be ordered up to 2x mid-term.
- Security: we'll provide SOC 2 evidence and a sandbox-specific audit log export schedule in the SOW appendix.

Attachments: updated SOW (I attached the SOW with amendment language) and the pricing workbook. DocuSign envelope link: https://www.docusign.com/en/mediform/DF-7842

Acceptance asks:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the provisioning timeline (we can hit late Q1 if SOW signed by Nov 15).
2) If you accept the 24-month term + 7% discount and uplift terms, we'll send the DocuSign for signatures.

Would you like Karthik to run a short isolation controls call with your infra team this week? If yes, propose Wed 10:00 AM PT.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — request to add isolated analytics sandbox and term change

Mina — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear terms. Mediform is prepared to move forward with the 24-month term and the 7% discount under the conditions you listed. We can commit to the procurement timeline if we receive the SOW and DocuSign by Nov 1; procurement needs two weeks to issue the PO.

A couple of asks before signature: 
- Please include a one-page appendix listing SOC2 artifacts we'll receive and a cadence for sandbox audits (weekly usage logs, monthly export).
- For on-prem deployment of the analytics cluster (we may opt for a partial on-prem footprint for low-latency scoring), can you include an ops window estimate and an estimated on-prem install fee? We expect to decide on the on-prem option within 30 days of signing.

If everything looks good we'll sign the DocuSign and route PO. Wed 10:00 AM PT for the isolation call works for our infra lead (Rajesh).

Thanks — looking forward to closing.
Elena
